summary: The derived Default implementation initializes RopeBuilder with an empty stack. Appending a leaf then panics at self.stack.pop().unwrap(), and finishing an empty builder can underflow the stack index. The fix implements Default through Self::new(), which initializes the required empty leaf. The regression test added by this commit builds a rope using RopeBuilder::default() and checks its contents and invariants. The proposed verbatim reversal restores the derive and removes the manual Default implementation while preserving the test. No builds or tests were run.
